name: waterlogging-project-root
description: AI-Based Waterlogging Detection and Drainage Advisory System Using Multi-Source Satellite Imagery

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,cyan" "python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir ml_service --port 8000" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,cyan" "python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir ml_service --port 8000" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
